name: Review tree.py for unbounded recursion
prompt: Review tree.py for correctness issues. Do NOT modify any code — this is a read-only review task. Write your findings to REVIEW.md in this repository. In particular, check whether the recursion has a base case. REVIEW.md must identify the issue by name.
test_command: import pathlib; t=pathlib.Path('REVIEW.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').lower(); assert 'recursion' in t, 'REVIEW.md must identify the recursion problem'
